SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
What were the largest withdrawals from the Treasury's cash account over fiscal 2024?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND transaction_type = 'Withdrawals' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many forms in the collection come from federal, New York State and New York City agencies?
SELECT gov, count(*) AS forms FROM govblock_reference.forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the most drunk-driving fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(drunk_dr AS integer) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which industries do prime awards that pass work to sub-awardees come from most often?
SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many generators are planned to retire, by the operators' own reports?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE trim(planned_retirement_year) <> ''
Which organisms are tested in the most ChEMBL assays?
SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules
Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many skilled nursing facility cost reports were filed for fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2025'
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most published patent applications?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'
How are hospitals filing fiscal 2023 cost reports owned: nonprofit, for-profit or government?

SELECT CASE WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('1', '2') THEN 'Nonprofit' WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') THEN 'For-profit' ELSE 'Government' END AS ownership, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
When does the New York grid operator's fuel mix record begin?
SELECT min(date_parse(time_stamp, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS first_reading FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix
Which organisations reported the most federal spending in their 2023 single audits?
SELECT auditee_name, try_cast(total_amount_expended AS double) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much in import duties did the United States collect on goods arriving in 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cal_dut_mo AS double)) AS duties FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl WHERE year = '2024'
Which states have the most active Davis-Bacon wage determinations?
SELECT states, count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'dbra' AND is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Is more money passed down as sub-grants or as sub-contracts?
SELECT subaward_type, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of patent ownership change are recorded most often?
SELECT convey_ty, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment_conveyance GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is New York State's estimated population for 2025?
SELECT try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' AND stname = 'New York'
Which diseases have the most drugs approved or in clinical trials?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are hazardous waste generators split between large, small and very small quantity?
SELECT hreport_universe_record, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How are judges' recorded party affiliations split?

SELECT CASE political_party WHEN 'd' THEN 'Democratic' WHEN 'r' THEN 'Republican' WHEN 'i' THEN 'Independent' WHEN 'f' THEN 'Federalist' WHEN 'w' THEN 'Whig' ELSE political_party END AS party, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_political_affiliations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the pharmacy acquisition cost of Lantus insulin changed year by year?

SELECT substr(effective_date, 7, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 2) AS avg_cost_per_unit FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'LANTUS%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
